data.instructions:
Tutorial 2/7:
Minor vs Major errors:
Every error span you mark must be assigned one of two severity levels:
Minor:The meaning is essentially preserved. A reader would notice the translation is slightly awkward or imprecise, but would still understand the message correctly. Minor errors include small word choice differences, minor grammar issues, or slight shifts in tone that do not change the core meaning.
Major:The meaning is changed, lost, or seriously misleading. The reader could misunderstand the intent or act on wrong information. Major errors include hallucinated translation, reversed meanings, dropped key information, or incorrect numbers.
Once you detect an error, click on the beginning and end of the span and mark it as a minor or major error. You will have the above short description of minor and major errors during the annotation.

Now let's try an example:
The word "longest" is incorrect in the following translation. The Italian word "lontana" means "farthest" not "longest".
This is a Minor error: the meaning is fully preserved, it is just a small word choice issue.
1. Select and mark the word "longest" as a Minor error.
2. Move the slider to around 75–80% to reflect the reduced quality.

model-tutorial.warning: Please mark the word "longest" as a minor error (light pink) and set the score to 75-80%.

data.src: Howard Hu, il program manager per la navicella Orion, ha espresso la sua gioia per gli ultimi due giorni, dicendo che sono stati fantastici e che aveva a malapena dormito. Ha anche dichiarato in una conferenza stampa che il processo di volo dal lancio all'inserimento in orbita è proceduto in modo molto fluido e con successo.

tgt.model-tutorial: Howard Hu, the program manager for the Orion spacecraft, expressed his delight at the past two days, saying they were unsuccessful and that he had barely slept. He also stated at a press conference that the flight process from launch to orbit insertion had proceeded very smoothly and successfully.

data.instructions:
Tutorial 3/7:
Using the 0-100 quality score slider:

The slider captures your overall judgment. It is not just a count of errors, but how much those errors hurt the translation quality.

Considering the above guideline on the range of scores, let's mark a major error and set a proper score.
The word "unsuccessful" is completely wrong in the given translation; it means the opposite of the Italian "fantastici" (fantastic).
1. Select and mark "unsuccessful" as a major error.
2. Move the slider to 25-30% due to the serious error.

model-tutorial.warning: Please mark "unsuccessful" as a major error (dark pink) and set the score to 25-30%.

data.src: "Ora stiamo tentando di nuovo la stessa cosa, ma con uno scopo diverso. Questa volta, torneremo sulla luna per imparare a vivere, lavorare e creare per l'ulteriore esplorazione spaziale. Questo piano è la preparazione per l'umanità per andare su Marte alla fine degli anni 2030, e anche oltre."

tgt.model-tutorial: "We are now attempting the same thing again, but with a different purpose. We are returning to the moon to learn how to live, work, and create for further space exploration. This plan is preparation for humanity to go to Mars in the late 2030s, and even beyond."

data.instructions:
Tutorial 4/7:
Handling omitted content with [missing]:

When a source content is completely missing from the translation, you cannot click a span on words that are not there. In this case, use the [missing] tag to mark the location of the omission.

Let's tag the missing part:
Read the given source text carefully. As you may have noticed, the translation of "Questa volta" (meaning "this time") is missing from the target text. This is a minor error since this omission has not changed the meaning of text.
1. Mark the [missing] tag as a Minor error.
2. Set the score to 65–75%.

model-tutorial.warning: Please mark the [missing] tag as a Minor error and set the score to 65–75%.

data.src: Questa fa parte di "Hakuto-R", il primo progetto di esplorazione lunare finanziato da privati, in cui il lander lunare si dirigerà lentamente verso la luna nel corso di diversi mesi. Se l'atterraggio ha successo, il piano è di schierare la sonda Rashid degli Emirati Arabi Uniti e un piccolo robot simile sviluppato dalla Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) per studiare le proprietà del suolo lunare.

tgt.model-tutorial: This is part of "Hakuto-R," the first privately funded lunar exploration project, in which the lunar lander will slowly make its way to the moon over several months. If the landing is successful, the plan is to deploy the United Arab Emirates' Rashid probe and a similar small robot developed by the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) to study the properties of the lunar soil.

model-tutorial.warning: This translation is excellent. Please don't mark any errors and set the score to 95-100%.

data.src: La dott.ssa Katie Joy dell'Università di Manchester nel Regno Unito ha detto che i nuovi campioni riportati da Chang'e 5 porteranno anche a una migliore comprensione della storia dei vulcani lunari.

tgt.model-tutorial-A: Dr. Katie Joy of the University of Manchester in the UK said that the new samples brought back by Chang'e 5 will also lead to a better understanding of the history of lunar volcanoes.

data.instructions:
Tutorial 6/7:
Annotating more than one translation for a source text:

Here you are given two translations of the same source. You need to follow the rules from the previous examples and mark the error spans, assign severities, and give a 0–100% score to each translation separately. Remember lower quality translations should be assigned lower scores.
One of the translations is accurate. Set the score to 90-100%.

The other translation has two major errors. The words "nuovi" (new) and "storia" (history) are translated incorrectly to "old" and "future", respectively. Having two major errors, set the score to 10-20%.

data.src: "Questa missione si sta dirigendo verso un'area in cui sappiamo che ci sono state eruzioni vulcaniche in passato. Vogliamo scoprire esattamente quando si sono verificate quelle eruzioni", ha detto la dott.ssa Joy a BBC News.

tgt.model-tutorial-A: "This mission is heading to an area where we know there have been volcanic eruptions and water sources in the past. We want to find out exactly when those eruptions occurred," Dr. Joy told BBC News.
tgt.model-tutorial-B: "This mission is heading to an area where we know there have been volcanic eruptions in the past. We want to find out exactly where those eruptions occurred," Dr. Joy told BBC News.

data.instructions:
Tutorial 7/7:
Document-level annotation

In some cases you are given multiple source texts from the same document. While annotating each target text, keep in mind the dependencies across source texts when identifying error spans.

Now let's walk through the following example. In one translation, "and water sources" is a hallucinated phrase that does not appear in the source text. Mark the entire phrase as a major error span and set the score to 0. In the second translation, "quando" is mistakenly translated as "where". Since this changes the meaning of the sentence, mark it as a major error and set the score to 50–60%.
